title: Integration Bridge: Weekly Standup Notes — 2026-12-03
content:
Summary:
Weekly sync for Solutions Engineering + Professional Services (Integration Bridge). Focused on three active customer integrations, two runway risks, infra quota requests, and next-week rollout windows. Meeting recorded in Slack thread; decisions captured below.

Attendees:
- Priya Kapoor (Owner, SE)
- Ethan Morales (ProServices PM)
- Grace Lin (Field Eng)
- Omar Haddad (SRE)
- Riley Thompson (Customer Success)
- Sandra Park (Solution Architect)
- Optional: notes from on-call infra (as needed)

Agenda:
1) Quick status ticks (each customer)
2) Blockers and escalations -> SRE/infra handoff
3) Upcoming deployment windows and rollback criteria
4) Action items + owners
5) Risk log updates + capacity ask

Customer Integrations (current sprint):
1) Aurelia Bank — pilot (PII + private deployment)
- Status: late-stage integration; private deployment package is being validated in Aurelia's VPC. Golden-path flows tested (document ingestion -> search -> LLM responses).
- This week: completed KMS key rotation test and audit log export to S3 staging. Data ingress pipeline (SFTP -> ingestion lambda) still flaky for large files (>200MB).
- Blocker: ingestion lambda times out intermittently when handling large PDF bundles. Observed retry storms on 2026-12-01 (see PROSERV-2183).
- Root cause hypothesis: cold-starts + memory pressure when libextractor spawns multiple threads.
- Mitigation underway: Grace elevated to infra to add a warm-scaling policy and bump lambda memory to 2048MB for the customer staging account. Estimated mitigation rollout: 2026-12-06.
- Next steps: run full pilot ingestion (10 sample customer corp docs) after mitigation; Priya to schedule with Aurelia on 2026-12-07.
- Acceptance criteria for go/no-go to production: successful ingestion of 10 files in <5m, audit log checks present, KMS rotation validated.

2) KiteStream — hosted-api migration (multi-tenant public)
- Status: migration to hosted Redwood API in progress; we completed schema alignment and API key rotation.
- This week: Canary traffic (1% of requests) ran from 2026-12-02 to 2026-12-03. Error rate spiked to 2.8% on 2026-12-02 (baseline 0.4%).
- Investigation: errors correlated with tokenization exceptions for historical long-chat inputs (>8k tokens). Jira PROSERV-2220 created to track a tokenizer fallback.
- Temporary workaround: Canary throttled to 0.2% and long-chat inputs are pre-validated by KiteStream client before routing.
- Owner: Riley to coordinate with KiteStream SDK team to add client-side validation (ETA 2026-12-10).
- Infra ask: short-term quota bump on hosted inference pool for p3d instances to move more canary traffic into isolated pool — Omar to submit formal quota request (done) and monitor approval.

3) Nimbus Docs — dedicated (reserved capacity) onboarding
- Status: Dedicated cluster provisioning complete; model pinned to open-llama-13b-qlora variant. SME review scheduled for 2026-12-08.
- This week: performance tuning session with Nimbus; found inference tail latency increases when concurrent KV-cache warmups occur (spikes ~120ms).
- SRE note: observed suboptimal kernel choice for 7-layer attention pattern on 13B variant; workaround: force CUDA kernel version 2.1 for the batch path (ops-config PR #476).
- Blocker: Nimbus requires 99.9% availability SLA for business hours (08:00–20:00 ET). Current dedicated autoscaler policy has slow cold-start behavior for scale-from-zero.
- Action: Solutions + SRE to prototype a warm-warm pool (always-on minimal instances) for Nimbus for a 30-day trial; metrics to evaluate: tail latency, cost delta, and user impact. Pilot start: 2026-12-15.

Runway Risks and Escalations:
- Risk 1 (Aurelia ingestion): If lambda mitigation delayed >72 hours, pilot timeline slips 2 weeks. Impact: quarterly revenue recognition risk for late pilot and delayed PO. Escalation: notify Sales lead and Finance.
- Risk 2 (KiteStream tokenizer): If tokenizer fallback engineering >2 weeks, KiteStream may pause migration leading to increased support costs. Escalation path: Solutions -> Product-hosted-api -> Applied-ML (tokenizer team).
- Risk 3 (Nimbus SLA vs autoscaler): Cost vs latency trade-off; need exec sign-off for always-on baseline. Prepare cost delta estimate by 2026-12-09.

Operational Metrics Snapshot (last 7 days):
- Total integration runs: 124
- Avg ingestion time (Aurelia staging): 67s (tail 95th 420s)
- Hosted API error rate (KiteStream canary): 0.9% (spike 2.8%)
- Dedicated tail latency (Nimbus): p95 210ms, spikes to 330ms during KV warmups

Decisions Made:
- Bump Aurelia staging lambda memory to 2048MB and enable warm-scaling (Grace/Omar).
- Throttle KiteStream canary to 0.2% until tokenizer fallback is in place (Riley).
- Approve 30-day warm-warm pool pilot for Nimbus; measure cost/latency trade-offs (Priya + Omar).

Action Items (owners + due dates):
- Grace: deploy lambda memory bump + warm-scaling to Aurelia staging (ETA 2026-12-06).
- Omar: submit hosted inference quota bump and monitor approval; implement kernel force change for dedicated runtime (ops-config PR watch) (ETA 2026-12-05).
- Riley: coordinate KiteStream SDK change for client-side long-chat validation; provide PR link (ETA 2026-12-10).
- Priya: schedule Aurelia pilot re-run and update customer-facing runbook (ETA 2026-12-07).
- Sandra: draft cost delta estimate for Nimbus warm-pool and circulate for exec review (ETA 2026-12-09).
- Ethan: update risk register and notify Sales/Finance of Aurelia slip risk if mitigation delayed (ETA 2026-12-04).

Meeting Notes / Misc Observations:
- Template suggestion: add a short section at top of future notes for "Required decisions" so executives can scan quickly.
- We observed cross-team communication friction between Product-hosted-api and Applied-ML around tokenizer behavior; propose a 30-min alignment session next Tuesday (2026-12-08). Priya to coordinate.
- Customer comms: KiteStream PM requested a one-page summary of rollback criteria for hosted migration — Riley to deliver by 2026-12-06.

Next Sync:
- Recurring weekly on Wednesdays, 09:30 PT. Next meeting: 2026-12-10.

Appendix (quick refs):
- PROSERV-2183: Aurelia ingestion lambda timeouts (log snippets included in Jira).
- PROSERV-2220: KiteStream tokenizer fallback work.
- ops-config PR #476: force kernel v2.1 for batch path (linked above).
- Slack: #proservices-aurelia-thread-2026-11-30 contains audit log excerpts and KMS test artifacts.

Notes saved by: Priya Kapoor
